answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by tying emission to scarce, peer-reviewed work rather than to headcount. Imagine a lagoon of new accounts that can only paddle near shore: they earn almost nothing until their answers survive independent grading and countersignature. Only after that climb does an identity reach the summit of established status, and only sustained, verdict-matched work can hold the zenith where payout caps and locked stake make spinning extra wallets a losing trade.
